title: Change the contact details on a company or partnership contractor licence
summary: Update your company or partnership contractor licence details if your contact information has changed.
intro: If you hold a company or partnership contractor licence and your contact details have changed (email address, address or phone number), you must update the licence details within 7 days.
who_can_apply: Hold a company or partnership contractor licence
Have changed contact details (email address, address, or phone number)
what_you_need: Your old and new contact details
The PDF form – 'Notification of Change of Address'

how_to_steps.text: Submit your notification at a Service NSW Centre or by email to the details on the form.

external_links.text: Form HB024: Notification of Change of Address – PDF

faqs.q: How quickly must I update my contact details?
faqs.a: If you hold a company or partnership contractor licence and your contact details have changed (email address, address or phone number), you must update the licence details within 7 days.

faqs.q: How do I update my contact details?
faqs.a: Select the 'Download PDF form' button, complete and sign the form, and submit your notification at a Service NSW Centre or by email to the details on the form.
